body:
Adds `research/tail-elicitation`: a scale-invariant Fissler–Ziegel score for jointly eliciting (VaR, ES) of benign floating-point drift, a proof that ES alone is non-elicitable (explicit mixture), exact closed-form regret, and sample-size rules for catching an understated tail. Stdlib-only, 10 tests, white paper, README and portfolio page entries.
